changes: First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54: the LOOPER machine turns one audio track into a live looper that records the master mix or inputs all the time.
CAPT and ONCE catch the loop playing now with FILL or UP; PICK keeps it playing through pattern changes with no trigs, and PTCH or WARP follow the tempo.
Push D on its SRC page to keep a loop as a sample through the stock trim editor.
Based on sumedho's RAM Machines, with one machine of its own; it cannot be combined with RAM Machines or Digi Health.
Known issues: the loop is lost at power-off; a small click ends each take; changing PLAY mode mid-play restarts the loop; an open Overbridge instance slows the unit.
